A slice has been cut, revealing the dense, ground meat interior with visible flecks of ingredients. To the right is a serving of bright green curly parsley or similar garnish. In the background, there is a blue and white jar labeled 'SALAD DRESSING' (text is partially legible but slightly distorted).
